description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ConfigurationSupportingVerticle' that extends Vert.x's 'AbstractVerticle'. It provides support for managing configuration properties for verticles, including setting and getting configuration objects of generic type T, with an emphasis on subclass interaction and dependency injection.

classes.name: ConfigurationSupportingVerticle
classes.description: An abstract class supporting configuration management for Vert.x verticles, allowing subclasses to set and get configuration objects of a generic type.

methods.name: setSpecificConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration object of type T to be used by the verticle.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to set configuration properties, possibly with dependency injection annotations.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration object that has been set.
